description: Korean income-contingent student loan (취업 후 상환 학자금) mandatory repayment: (annual income amount − repayment threshold 20,560,000 KRW, 교육부고시 제2026-12호, ≈ gross salary 30,370,000) × 20% undergraduate or 25% graduate (특별법 제18조, 시행령 제10조), monthly payroll deduction (1/12, from the month after the June notice) or a bill after the May income tax filing. Salary input is converted with the earned income deduction. The threshold changes each semester. Estimate only.

amount.description: Gross salary or income amount for the year (KRW)

employee.description: Wage earner (payroll deduction) — default true for salary

incomeType.description: salary = gross wages only, income = total income amount (소득금액)

loan.description: Undergraduate loans only, or graduate loans included
